notes.title: The Copper Canyon Shoot Out is Released
notes.content:
Howdy Partners,

[b]The Copper Canyon Shoot Out[/b] is out today! We're super excited to bring you the first game from Black Dragon Studios! We really hope you all enjoy it. We'd like to give huge thanks to everyone on our discord group for the feedback and input throughout development, your help has been super appreciated!
We really hope you all enjoy the game, and we'll be here and on discord ( https://discord.gg/aGtsJTU ) if you want to talk to us.

We'll see you in the Copper Canyon.
